sentiment_score_definition: x <= -0.35: Bearish; -0.35 < x <= -0.15: Somewhat-Bearish; -0.15 < x < 0.15: Neutral; 0.15 <= x < 0.35: Somewhat_Bullish; x >= 0.35: Bullish
relevance_score_definition: 0 < x <= 1, with a higher score indicating higher relevance.

feed.title: Brighthouse’s $4.1 Billion Takeover Drags as Regulators Dig In
feed.summary: Aquarian Holdings has missed its initial deadline to acquire Brighthouse Financial Inc. for $4.1 billion as regulators scrutinize the deal. The Delaware insurance regulator has questioned Aquarian's funding sources and management plans for Brighthouse's balance sheet, leading to investor doubt as Brighthouse shares trade well below the deal price. Aquarian is backed by Mubadala Capital, but is still seeking additional investors to complete the acquisition by the new December 6th deadline.

feed.title: Bank of Montreal admits HK$850m senior notes to LSE trading
feed.summary: Bank of Montreal has listed HK$850 million in senior notes on the London Stock Exchange's main market. These Series 497 notes, part of a larger U.S.$40 billion program, carry a 3.540% fixed interest rate and mature on August 31, 2027. The offering is not registered under the U.S. Securities Act and is restricted to eligible counterparties and professional clients under UK MiFIR and MiFID II rules.

feed.title: Candel Therapeutics at Cantor global healthcare conference: prostate cancer push
feed.summary: Candel Therapeutics presented at the 12th Annual Cantor Fitzgerald Global Healthcare Conference, highlighting its lead prostate cancer program and broader viral immunotherapy pipeline. The company emphasized strong late-stage data for aglatimogen in localized prostate cancer, aiming for a biologics license application submission by the end of 2025. CEO Paul Peter Tak discussed the clinical relevance of its disease-free survival endpoint, the regulatory path with the FDA, and ongoing manufacturing and biomarker work.

feed.title: UBS reiterates Deckers Outdoor stock Buy rating on brand strength
feed.summary: UBS has reiterated a Buy rating for Deckers Outdoor (NYSE:DECK) stock, setting a price target of $161.00. The firm expects strong revenue growth from the Hoka and UGG brands to drive positive surprises, projecting high-single-digit sales growth and low-double-digit EPS growth over five years. Despite some analyst concerns about demand and competition, UBS views Deckers Outdoor as an undervalued growth company.

feed.title: Adobe Pulls Back, Then Recovers as CEO Handoff Meets Soft Q4 Outlook; Intuit and ServiceNow Hold Steady
feed.summary: Adobe experienced a stock wobble despite beating Q3 estimates and raising its full-year outlook, primarily due to a soft Q4 revenue guidance and simultaneous CEO and CFO transitions. While Adobe's stock initially dropped 3% before recovering, peers Intuit and ServiceNow remained steady, indicating that the market reaction was specific to Adobe rather than a broader tech trend. The company's record Q3 revenue and significant AI ARR growth were overshadowed by investor unease regarding the leadership changes and conservative Q4 outlook.

feed.title: Expeditors International stock hits all-time high of 192.34 USD
feed.summary: Expeditors International of Washington Inc. (EXPD) stock has reached an all-time high of $192.34, reflecting a significant 55.11% increase over the past year. Despite appearing overvalued by InvestingPro analysis, the company demonstrates financial strength with 29 consecutive years of dividend increases. Recent strong revenue growth led UBS and BofA Securities to raise price targets, while Expeditors also expanded its Aircraft on Ground logistics services.

feed.title: BMO targets Canada’s next era of growth with commitment of up to $70 billion for critical economic sectors
feed.summary: BMO has announced a commitment to mobilize up to $70 billion in new capital over 10 years for critical Canadian economic sectors such as electricity, energy, transportation infrastructure, mining, AI computing, defence, and oil & gas. This initiative aims to support Canada's economic security, resilience, and long-term growth by financing key projects and businesses. The capital mobilization reinforces BMO's historical role in Canadian development and its ongoing efforts to help the country compete in the global economy.

feed.title: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Steel Dynamics Price Target to $301 From $300, Maintains Buy Rating
feed.summary: Goldman Sachs has increased its price target for Steel Dynamics (STLD) to $301 from $300, while reiterating a Buy rating on the stock. This adjustment reflects a positive outlook from the financial institution on the steel manufacturer. The article also notes other recent analyst adjustments and company news, including dividend announcements and management changes.

feed.title: Tesla’s Trucking Business Could Unlock A $17B Software Opportunity, Morgan Stanley Says
feed.summary: Morgan Stanley suggests that Tesla's autonomous trucking software could generate $17 billion in revenue and $7.5 billion in incremental EBIT by 2040, based on a projected $500 billion to $1.1 trillion U.S. autonomous trucking market by 2041. The firm estimates that the software could yield $12,000 to $18,000 in monthly revenue per truck, assuming Tesla has 82,000 Semis on the road. Despite this potential, Tesla's shares are down over 19% year-to-date, making it the worst-performing stock among the "Magnificent 7."

feed.title: Barclays reduces stake in Central Asia Metals to 5.62%
feed.summary: Barclays PLC has reduced its holding in Central Asia Metals PLC to 5.62% from 5.66%, crossing a key threshold on September 9. The banking group's total position now comprises 3.52% voting rights attached to shares and 2.10% through financial instruments. Barclays Capital Securities Limited holds the direct voting rights, with additional voting rights held via rights to recall, contracts for difference, and portfolio swaps.

feed.title: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US restructures board and appoints Sungjoon Chae as director
feed.summary: Apimeds Pharmaceuticals US has announced a restructuring of its board of directors and the appointment of Sungjoon Chae as a new director. This change follows an amendment to a previous settlement agreement involving the company and its subsidiaries. Sungjoon Chae, who also serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer, joins the board after being nominated by the Inscobee Parties.

feed.title: Aramark Facilities Management's Proprietary TwinOptix® Platform Earns 2026 FacilitiesNet Vision Award
feed.summary: Aramark Facilities Management's TwinOptix® platform has been recognized with the 2026 FacilitiesNet Vision Award. This award highlights the platform's innovative approach and contribution to the facilities management industry.

feed.title: $6 diesel should benefit Tesla's trucking ambitions, Morgan Stanley says
feed.summary: Surging diesel prices, which have surpassed $6 a gallon, could significantly boost the demand for Tesla's electric semi-trucks, according to Morgan Stanley analysts. An autonomous electric semi is projected to cut costs by 20% per mile and increase annual mileage by 133% compared to human-operated diesel vehicles. This could lead to a dramatic increase in profit per truck, making Tesla's trucking solution more attractive amidst rising fuel costs.

feed.title: Is Cintas (CTAS) Outperforming Other Consumer Discretionary Stocks This Year?
feed.summary: Cintas (CTAS) is outperforming other Consumer Discretionary stocks this year, with a year-to-date return of 5.5% compared to the sector's average loss of 12.3%. The company holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), driven by improving analyst sentiment and a positive earnings outlook. PIGEON CORP (PGENY) is another Consumer Discretionary stock showing strong performance, up 15.2% year-to-date, also with a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

feed.title: Bonk redeems 26.7% of Series A preferred stock for $4 million
feed.summary: Bonk, Inc. (NASDAQ:BNKK) has redeemed 26.7% of its Series A Preferred Stock from Core4 Capital Holdings Corp for $4 million, reducing Core4’s holdings and eliminating anti-dilution rights. CEO Jarrett Boon stated this action defends shareholder value, cleans up the capital structure, and provides a clear path for future growth. The redeemed shares have been retired and restored to unissued status.

feed.title: Turn Therapeutics to Present at Stifel 2026 Virtual Immunology and Inflammation Forum
feed.summary: Turn Therapeutics Inc. will present at the Stifel 2026 Virtual Immunology and Inflammation Forum on September 23, 2026, at 1:30 PM ET. CEO Bradley Burnam and Executive Clinical and Regulatory Lead Stephen M. Hahn, M.D., will discuss the company's atopic dermatitis clinical program, including its pruritus-focused stage 2 enrichment strategy and findings across diverse patient populations. A live webcast and replay will be available on the company's investor relations website.

feed.title: BMO commits up to $70-billion in new capital to shore up critical sectors
feed.summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO) has pledged up to $70 billion in new capital over the next decade to support critical sectors of Canada's economy, including electricity, energy, transportation, mining, AI, and defence. This initiative aligns with the Canadian government's push to strengthen economic security and reduce reliance on the United States. Other Canadian banks, such as RBC, CIBC, Scotiabank, and National Bank, are also making similar commitments to bolster key industries.

feed.title: TJX (TJX) Loses 17.8% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why a Trend Reversal May be Around the Corner
feed.summary: TJX (TJX) has seen a 17.8% decline in its stock price over the last four weeks, but indicators suggest a potential trend reversal. Its Relative Strength Index (RSI) of 17.78 indicates the stock is oversold, while a 0.6% increase in consensus EPS estimates for the current year, driven by analyst revisions, points to a fundamental improvement. Additionally, the stock holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy), further supporting the likelihood of a near-term rebound.

feed.summary: This article announces that Alliance Entertainment Holding Corp filed a Form 8K on September 10. The filing is available for review on Investing.com. The article itself provides minimal detail beyond the announcement.

feed.title: Alliance Entertainment FY 2026 slides: 8% revenue growth, 24% EPS gain
feed.summary: Alliance Entertainment (NASDAQ: AENT) reported robust fiscal year 2026 results, with an 8% revenue increase to $1.15 billion and a 24% rise in adjusted diluted EPS to $0.46, driven by strong demand for physical entertainment media and collectibles. The company's shares rallied significantly following the announcement, reflecting investor confidence in its strategic shift towards premium collectibles, authentication platforms, and technological advancements like AI and automation. While facing challenges such as negative operating cash flow due to working capital demands, Alliance Entertainment aims to continue its growth trajectory by leveraging studio partnerships, expanding its exclusive distribution network, and enhancing operational efficiency.

feed.title: REIT Alexandria Beats Investor Suit Over Property Write-Downs
feed.summary: Alexandria Real Estate Equities Inc., a life sciences landlord, has successfully defended against an investor lawsuit alleging that the company concealed weakening property values and delayed recording billions in losses. A US District Court judge dismissed the proposed class action, ruling that the plaintiff failed to sufficiently prove that the REIT's executives intentionally or recklessly misled investors. The court found that the investor did not adequately link the executives to the company's accounting analyses or impairment procedures.

feed.title: Is JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) a Buy as Wall Street Analysts Look Optimistic?
feed.summary: JPMorgan Chase & Co. (JPM) currently has an average brokerage recommendation (ABR) of 2.00, indicating a "Buy" based on recommendations from 26 brokerage firms. However, the article cautions against relying solely on ABRs due to potential analyst bias, suggesting that the Zacks Rank, which incorporates earnings estimate revisions, provides a more reliable indicator for near-term stock performance. JPM currently holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) due to growing optimism in its earnings prospects.

feed.title: Lululemon’s newest bear sees more pain for stock after 81% rout
feed.summary: BMO Capital Markets initiated coverage on Lululemon Athletica Inc. with an "underperform" rating, citing a deeply challenged business, declining market share to rivals, and deteriorating sales in key regions. Analyst Kelly Crago believes the athletic wear company's turnaround will be difficult due to stale products, diminishing relevance among consumers, and a shift away from athleisure fashion, forecasting further stock declines and pressure on margins. Despite a new CEO, Heidi O’Neill, tasked with revitalizing the brand, BMO sees Lululemon's stock potentially bottoming at $50 given current market conditions and lack of clear turnaround visibility.

feed.title: Edwards Lifesciences stock price target maintained at $85 by Canaccord
feed.summary: Canaccord maintained a Hold rating and an $85.00 price target on Edwards Lifesciences following a Medicare coverage decision for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) procedures. The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) formalized Medicare coverage for asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis and removed facility-level procedural volume thresholds, which is expected to drive longer-term volume growth. Despite this positive development, Canaccord notes that the implementation and adoption of the new National Coverage Determination (NCD) will take time, influencing their cautious rating.

feed.title: Investors Heavily Search Abbott Laboratories (ABT): Here is What You Need to Know
feed.summary: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) has been a highly searched stock on Zacks.com, and this article provides an overview of factors influencing its near-term performance. It highlights earnings estimate revisions, revenue growth forecasts, and recent financial results as key indicators for potential investors. The stock currently holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), suggesting it may perform in line with the broader market.

feed.title: BofA Securities Adjusts PT on Packaging Corp. of America to $260 From $280, Maintains Buy Rating
feed.summary: BofA Securities has adjusted its price target for Packaging Corp. of America (PKG) to $260 from $280, while maintaining a Buy rating on the stock. This update reflects a revised valuation perspective for the paper packaging manufacturer. The article also provides recent news and financial data for Packaging Corp. of America, including dividend information and analyst ratings.

feed.title: Waters Corporation to Present at the J.P. Morgan U.S. All Stars Conference
feed.summary: Waters Corporation announced that its President and CEO, Udit Batra, Ph.D., will participate in a fireside chat at the J.P. Morgan U.S. All Stars Conference on September 23, 2026. The event will be webcast live on the company's Investor Relations website, with a replay available for 90 days. Waters Corporation is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, focused on analytical technologies and informatics.

feed.title: Anixa Biosciences CEO Amit Kumar acquires $13,799 in stock
feed.summary: Anixa Biosciences CEO Amit Kumar recently purchased 5,000 shares of the company's common stock for $13,799, at a price of $2.76 per share. This transaction increases his direct holdings to 662,000 shares, occurring while the stock is near its 52-week low. Despite the stock appearing overvalued by some analyses, the company maintains a strong balance sheet and is advancing its clinical trials for cancer therapies.

feed.title: Amit Kumar Acquires 5,000 Shares of Anixa Biosciences (NASDAQ:ANIX) Stock
feed.summary: Anixa Biosciences CEO Amit Kumar recently acquired 5,000 shares of the company's stock for $13,800, increasing his direct ownership to 662,000 shares. This purchase follows several other insider acquisitions in recent months. The company's stock opened at $2.75, down 2.8%, with a market capitalization of $93.6 million, and analysts currently hold a "Hold" rating with a $10 average price target.

feed.title: Edwards Lifesciences stock price target maintained at $85 by Canaccord
feed.summary: Canaccord has reiterated a Hold rating and an $85 price target for Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE:EW) after Medicare finalized coverage for transcatheter aortic valve replacement (TAVR) procedures, including those for asymptomatic severe aortic stenosis. Despite the stock trading above Canaccord's target at $86.77 and a premium valuation, 15 analysts have revised earnings downwards for the upcoming period, adding a cautious note to the Hold rating. The finalized Medicare policy is expected to be a long-term tailwind for TAVR due to formalized coverage, removal of facility volume thresholds, and increased workflow flexibility.

feed.title: NAPA Auto Parts parent company shares more details on company split
feed.summary: Genuine Parts Co., parent company of NAPA Auto Parts, has released more details regarding its plan to split its automotive and industrial businesses into two independent, publicly traded companies by Q1 2027. The automotive business will operate as Genuine Parts Co. (GPC) and the industrial business as Motion. The company has also announced key leadership appointments for both entities, with Court Carruthers becoming CEO-elect of GPC and Will Stengel serving as chairman and CEO of Motion.

feed.title: Anixa Biosciences and Nexalin Technology Interviews to Air Nationally on the RedChip Small Stocks, Big Money(TM) Show on CNBC and Bloomberg TV
feed.summary: RedChip Companies will air interviews with Anixa Biosciences Inc. (NASDAQ:ANIX) and Nexalin Technology Inc. (NASDAQ:NXL) on their "Small Stocks, Big Money™" show. The interviews will be broadcast on Bloomberg TV on September 12 and on CNBC on September 13. Anixa Biosciences will discuss its breast cancer vaccine, while Nexalin Technology will highlight its drug-free neurostimulation platform for mental health and neurological disorders.

feed.title: Amazon vs. Alphabet: If I Could Buy Only One, I’d Choose This Stock
feed.summary: This article compares Amazon (AMZN) and Alphabet (GOOG), focusing on their Q2 2026 performance and AI infrastructure investments. While both tech giants show significant growth in cloud services, the author argues that Alphabet presents a more favorable investment due to its valuation, higher operating margins, and superior stock performance over the past year. The piece highlights Alphabet's strategic bets on AI through Gemini and Waymo, despite increased debt, and concludes by favoring Alphabet over Amazon.

feed.title: Stephens Adjusts Price Target on EOG Resources to $175 From $168, Maintains Equalweight Rating
feed.summary: Stephens has adjusted its price target for EOG Resources (EOG) to $175, an increase from the previous $168, while maintaining an Equalweight rating on the stock. This update reflects a re-evaluation of the oil and gas exploration and production company by the firm. EOG Resources specializes in the sale of crude oil, natural gas, and liquefied natural gas, primarily operating in the United States.

feed.title: Adobe Forecast Misses Estimates, Renewing Fears About AI Impact
feed.summary: Adobe Inc.'s sales forecast narrowly missed analysts' estimates, reigniting concerns among investors about the impact of AI competitors on the company. The software maker's shares dropped following the announcement, reflecting ongoing investor unease, especially given the rise of generative AI tools that offer alternatives to Adobe's traditional products. The company also announced a new CEO, Anil Chakravarthy, a decision that surprised some investors as he previously led a smaller division.

feed.title: Q2 Earnings Review: Industrial Packaging Stocks Led by Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY)
feed.summary: The article reviews the Q2 earnings season for industrial packaging stocks, highlighting Avery Dennison (NYSE:AVY) as a top performer with strong revenue growth. It also details the performance of other key players like Crown Holdings, Packaging Corporation of America, International Paper, and Silgan Holdings, noting that while the sector reported strong revenues, share prices have generally declined since earnings reports. The piece touches on recent market uncertainties, including AI and geopolitical events, but emphasizes the importance of strong fundamentals.

feed.title: Do Options Traders Know Something About Netflix Stock We Don't?
feed.summary: This article explores whether unusual options activity in Netflix (NFLX) stock indicates an upcoming significant price movement. High implied volatility in Netflix options suggests that traders are anticipating a large swing, potentially due to an impending event. Despite this, analysts currently rate Netflix as a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold), with recent earnings estimate revisions being mixed.

feed.title: Francisco Partners, KKR to buy minority stakes in Italy's TeamSystem, sources say
feed.summary: Private equity firms Francisco Partners and KKR have agreed to acquire minority stakes in the Italian software company TeamSystem from its main investor, Hellman & Friedman (H&F). The deal values TeamSystem between EUR8 billion and EUR10 billion, allowing H&F to divest part of its investment amid a challenging market for software stocks. This transaction is seen as an encouraging sign for private equity firms with significant software holdings, demonstrating the ability to reduce stakes in major holdings through a private IPO process.

feed.title: Deutsche Bank Adjusts FactSet Research Systems Price Target to $299 From $280, Maintains Hold Rating
feed.summary: Deutsche Bank has increased its price target for FactSet Research Systems (FDS) to $299 from $280, while maintaining a Hold rating on the stock. This adjustment comes amidst other analyst actions, including an upgrade from William Blair and a price target adjustment from Barclays, reflecting varied perspectives on the company's outlook. FactSet Research Systems specializes in financial data management and analysis for investors and financial professionals, with a significant user base and global revenue distribution.

feed.title: REG - Bank of Montreal Rotork PLC - Form 8.3 - Rotork PLC
feed.summary: Bank of Montreal has filed a Form 8.3 disclosure related to Rotork PLC, indicating their interests and short positions in the company's 0.5p Ordinary shares. The disclosure details the total number of relevant securities owned and controlled, as well as cash-settled derivative positions. It also reports recent purchase dealings by Bank of Montreal in Rotork PLC shares and corresponding cash-settled derivative transactions.

feed.title: Piper Sandler initiates Jack Henry stock coverage with neutral rating By Investing.com
feed.summary: Piper Sandler has initiated coverage on Jack Henry & Associates Inc. (NASDAQ:JKHY) with a Neutral rating and a $171.00 price target, viewing the company as a high-quality infrastructure business with durable cash generation. Despite its strong fundamentals, including 22 consecutive years of dividend growth, the firm considers its current valuation full, seeing the risk-reward as balanced. This contrasts with InvestingPro’s Fair Value analysis, which suggests the stock might be undervalued.

feed.title: A flag of YPF gas and oil company flutters next to an Argentine flag outside the YPF headquarters in Buenos Aires
feed.summary: This article describes a Reuters photograph taken on April 17, 2012, showing the YPF and Argentine flags outside the YPF headquarters in Buenos Aires. The accompanying text explains that Argentina's move to nationalize YPF from Spain's Repsol, while controversial internationally, was widely supported by Argentine citizens who viewed it as a stand against global finance and past privatizations. The image captures a symbolic moment during a significant political and economic event in Argentina's history.

feed.title: BlackRock Capital Allocation Trust stock falls on rights offer
feed.summary: BlackRock Capital Allocation Trust (NYSE:BCAT) shares fell after announcing a rights offering, allowing shareholders to buy additional shares at a discount. Shareholders will receive one right per share, with five rights needed for one new share, and the subscription price will be determined in October 2026 based on market prices and NAV. The offer is intended to increase the fund's assets and capitalize on investment opportunities, with BlackRock Advisors covering all associated expenses.

feed.title: Cantor Fitzgerald reiterates Neutral on Incyte stock after conference
feed.summary: Cantor Fitzgerald has maintained a Neutral rating on Incyte (NASDAQ: INCY) following an investor breakfast at their Global Healthcare Conference. Incyte's management reinforced its strategy to achieve $3 billion to $4 billion in durable core business revenue by 2030, excluding Jakafi, and to advance five key pipeline candidates, with the company expecting to end the year with approximately $4 billion in cash and no debt. InvestingPro suggests the stock is undervalued with an 8% free cash flow yield, while other recent developments include a voluntary agreement with CMS regarding Jakafi pricing and various analyst ratings changes based on competitive and experimental treatment news.

feed.title: Piper Sandler initiates Global Payments stock coverage at neutral By Investing.com
feed.summary: Piper Sandler has initiated coverage on Global Payments Inc. (NYSE:GPN) with a neutral rating and a $101.00 price target. The firm highlighted Global Payments' merchant-processing scale and monetization opportunities, while noting ongoing debates surrounding integration, organic growth, margin conversion, free cash flow, and leverage. The stock is currently trading at $88.55 and InvestingPro analysis suggests it is undervalued, despite recent downward revisions in earnings expectations by analysts.

feed.title: Green Giant deal in Canada runs into regulatory hurdle
feed.summary: B&G Foods' planned sale of its Green Giant and Le Sieur brands in Canada to Nortera Foods has faced a regulatory roadblock from Canada's Competition Bureau. The bureau asserts the acquisition would harm competition by leading to higher prices and fewer choices, as Nortera is already a dominant processor of certain vegetables. B&G Foods is now exploring legal and operational alternatives to complete the transaction, which was originally announced in October 2025.

feed.title: Emerson CEO tops St. Louis executive compensation ranking as pay packages vary widely
feed.summary: Emerson Electric's CEO, Lal Karsanbhai, led the St. Louis-area public company executive compensation ranking in 2025 with $21.2 million. The article highlights the significant disparity in CEO pay, with some smaller companies' executives earning less than $100,000. It also provides a detailed breakdown of the total compensation, including salary, stock awards, and bonuses, for the top-paid CEOs.

feed.title: Barclays below 5% of Telecom Italia, disposal of financial instruments

This change, which occurred on September 4, was attributed to the disposal of financial instruments. The direct equity stake remained at 0.00%, with the reduction primarily from financial instruments like rights to recall lent shares and swaps.

feed.title: Costco Price Prediction: A $1,200 Target Comes Into Focus
feed.summary: Costco's recent stock pullback presents a rare buying opportunity, with 24/7 Wall St. setting a 12-month price target of $1,011.88 (12.13% upside) and a five-year target of $1,204.89. The company delivered a strong Q3 fiscal 2026 report with double-digit revenue growth and high membership renewal rates, contrasting with slower growth seen in competitors like Walmart. Analysts maintain a bullish outlook on Costco, driven by increasing executive memberships and digital sales.

feed.title: Fidelity National Information Services (NYSE:FIS) Now Covered by Analysts at Piper Sandler
feed.summary: Piper Sandler has initiated coverage of Fidelity National Information Services (FIS) with a "neutral" rating and a $42 price target, indicating a potential 9% upside. This comes amidst mixed analyst sentiment, with FIS holding a "Hold" consensus rating, and having recently surpassed quarterly earnings expectations.
